simple.meaning: מַחֲשָׁבָה (machăshâbâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a contrivance , i.e. (concretely) a texture , machine , or (abstractly) intention , plan (whether bad, a plot; or good, advice).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 6:5. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַחֲשָׁבָה (H4284) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.

timeline.evidenceText: Yahweh saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of man’s heart was continually only evil.
to devise skillful works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in bronze,
and to make skillful works, to work in gold, in silver, in bronze,
in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all kinds of skillful workmanship.

He has filled them with wisdom of heart to work all kinds of workmanship, of the engraver, of the skillful workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of those who do any workmanship, and of those who make skillful works.
For we must die, and are like water spilled on the ground, which can’t be gathered up again; neither does God take away life, but devises means, that he who is banished not be an outcast from him.

You, Solomon my son, know the God of your father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind; for Yahweh searches all hearts, and understands all the imaginations of the thoughts. If you seek him, he will be found by you; but if you forsake him, he will cast you off forever.
Yahweh, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this desire forever in the thoughts of the heart of your people, and prepare their heart for you;
Now I have sent a skillful man, endowed with understanding, of Huram my father’s,

In Jerusalem, he made devices, invented by skillful men, to be on the towers and on the battlements, with which to shoot arrows and great stones. His name spread far abroad, because he was marvelously helped until he was strong.
Esther spoke yet again before the king, and fell down at his feet, and begged him with tears to put away the mischief of Haman the Agagite, and his plan that he had planned against the Jews.

She said, “If it pleases the king, and if I have found favor in his sight, and the thing seem right to the king, and I am pleasing in his eyes, let it be written to reverse the letters devised by Haman, the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, which he wrote to destroy the Jews who are in all the king’s provinces.

but when this became known to the king, he commanded by letters that his wicked plan, which he had planned against the Jews, should return on his own head, and that he and his sons should be hanged on the gallows.
He frustrates the plans of the crafty,

Yahweh brings the counsel of the nations to nothing.
The counsel of Yahweh stands fast forever,

They conspire and lurk,

definitions.full: H4284. machashabah or machashebeth מַחֲשָׁבָה noun feminine thought, device (chiefly in poetry and late) — absolute ׳מ Jer 18:11 ; 49:30 ; מַחֲשֶׁ֫בֶת Ezek 38:10 ; מַחֲשָׁ֑בֶת Exod 35:33 ; 2Chr 2:13 ; construct מַחֲשֶׁבֶת Est 8:5 ; 2Chr 26:15 ; suffix מַחֲשַׁבְתּוֺ Est 8:3 ; 9:25 ; plural מַחֲשָׁבוֺת Jer 11:19 7 t.; מַחֲשְׁבֹת Exod 31:4 3 t.; construct מַחְשְׁבוֺת Isa 59:7 13 t.; מַחְשְׁבֹת Gen 6:5 ; suffix מַחְשְׁבוֺתַי Isa 55:8 etc. + 19 t. suffixes; — 1 thought: a. of man ׳מ אדם Psa 94:11 ; ׳מ לֵב 33:11 thoughts of the mind ; מ יצר ׳(כל) (לבׅ Gen 6:5 (J), 1Chr 28:9 ; 29:18 . b. of God ׳מ יהוה Micah 4:12 ; with אֶלֿ Psa 40:6 ; עַלֿ Jer 51:29 ; the thoughts of God are exceeding deep Psa 92:6 ; higher than man's thoughts Isa 55:8 (twice in verse); 55:9 (twice in verse). 2 device, plan, purpose Isa 55:7 ; 59:7 ; 65:2 ; 66:18 ; Jer 6:19 ; 18:12 ; Psa 56:6 ; Prov 19:21 ; Job 21:27 ; Lam 3:60-61 , Est 8:5 ; ׳מ חָרוּץ Prov 21:5 ; ׳מ עֲרוּמִים Job 5:12 ; ׳מ צדיקים Prov 12:5 ; ׳מ עמים Psa 33:10 ; ׳מ אֹון Isa 59:7 ; Jer 4:14 ; Prov 6:18 ; ׳מ רע 15:26 ; ׳מ שָׁלוֺם Jer 21:11 ; מ ׳חשׁב devise devices 2Sam 14:14 ; Jer 11:19 ; 18:11 , 18 ; 29:11 ; 49:20 , 30 ; 50:45 ; Ezek 38:10 ; Dan 11:24-25 , Est 8:3 ; 9:25 ; ׳מ as subject of נָכוֺן be established Prov 16:3 ; 20:18 ; מ ׳הפר break plans 15:22 . 3 invention Exod 31:4 ; 35:32-33 , 35 (all P), 2Chr 2:13 ; 26:15 (see חָשַׁב I 5 ).
